main_body: dead weeping tree with hanging branches and trunk
evidence: The tree is drawn as a flat front elevation: vertical ribbon-like branches hang straight down from rows 0-43 with no top-facing crown volume, and the trunk sits on a flat horizontal bar base (rows 52-55) with a straight horizontal bottom edge rather than radial 3/4 roots.

style.evidence: Unlike the Beodeul reference trees which have volumetric rounded canopies and radial roots, the candidate consists of repetitive vertical dark brown strands outlined in near-black and a flat horizontal base bar.
